shared_prediction: One fixed float64 L2 first candidate per current gallery, identical for every policy. SU computed from normalized-cosine top10; distance_top1 is negative nearest L2 distance. Minor L2/cosine tie differences are logged, not hidden. This is a new common-prediction comparison, not a replacement of original primary results.
confidence: Reuse prior frozen-grid1-u for k1. Exact confidence=count(calibration nonconformity<=current second candidate score)/(n_cal+1), derived algebraically from continuous-alpha IV-C inversion. No fitted free parameter or optimized grid. A zero count is unresolved; exact threshold is the largest eligible calibration score.
gates: none; nonempty=resolved selected-alpha conformal set contains at least one candidate; guard=original L2 first candidate still exists; both=conjunction. No candidate reranking. Same answer count within each scope; if too few eligible queries, declare infeasible and do not substitute smaller budget.
scopes: same pooled/height scopes as previous protocol; 61 identical masks and prior calibration/evaluation identities, no fresh independent confirmation
primary: Descriptive target25pct deletion at pooled50pct answers. All three budgets, heights, control25 and target50 reported. No new efficacy threshold or attempt to reverse prior primaryFAIL.
cost: CPU on existing real feature cache; no new GPU inference/training/download. Predicted <10min including independent review, <1GiB working memory. No claim of deployment memory reduction.
followup_scope: Pre-fixed formula-identical CAMP repetition on existing cohorts. No new independent data or reversal of original Sample4Geo efficacy gate.
confidence_dependency: CAMP confidence outputs produced under the jointly frozen protocol; runtime hashes of confidence metrics/query arrays added to STARTED.
